title: PPG-MS16 — Quote ↔ Post ↔ Cost Backflow (close the quote-to-ship loop with measurable variance)
description: Closes the loop the master roadmap claims: quote → post → cycle-time estimate → real-shop measured cycle → cost variance → recalibrated quote. Today quote_estimate, cycle_time_estimate, and actual_cost_calculate exist as separate dispatcher actions; no PPG-MS owns the round trip from emitted post back into quote calibration. MS16 closes that gap, making PPG a measurable revenue-impacting product, not just a code generator.
rationale: Coverage scrutiny flagged this as the highest business-value MISSING capability. The user explicitly invoked /quote-to-ship. Without quote→post→cost backflow, every quote PRISM produces is a guess against itself. With it, quote accuracy improves cut-by-cut and the shop owner can see — per machine, per material, per customer — where cost is being lost.
leverage_existing: quote_estimate + quote_compare_materials + quote_what_if + quote_price_breaks_advanced + instant_quote + quote_revise (business dispatcher)
actual_cost_calculate + actual_cost_variance + actual_cost_profitability + actual_cost_forecast + actual_cost_margin_alerts + actual_cost_trend (business dispatcher)
QuoteEstimatorEngine + ActualCostEngine + CapacityPlanningEngine + JobLifecycleEngine + OEEEngine (business engines, already wired)
PostOutcomeAggregatorEngine (PPG-MS11/U-PPGM67) — telemetry → outcome aggregation (this milestone consumes it for cost variance)
JM Die customer roster (100+ customers, src/data/jm-die-profile.ts) — for per-customer accuracy tracking

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: JM Die quotes an ITW shoulder-bolt die job: Hurco V11, D2, 100-piece run. Quoted at $4,200 (50 hr × $84/hr).
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms16: Job ships. Actual: 62 hr at the machine ($5,208 cost). Foreman knows it ran long but no system explains why. Next ITW quote stays at $84/hr × estimated hours; bid stays the same; PRISM never learns from the variance. Margin loss bleeds.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms16: Job ships. PostOutcomeAggregator records actual 62 hr. actual_cost_variance flags +24% over quoted. PRISM auto-decomposes the variance: 8 hr extra in roughing (kc1.1 underestimated for this Hurco — handed back to PPG-MS11), 4 hr extra in setup (programmer manually re-fixtured because workholding marginal — handed back to PPG-MS14). Next ITW D2 quote auto-adjusts: roughing rate +12%, setup +20%. The quote sharpens. The shop owner sees the per-machine, per-customer, per-material variance dashboard in real time.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: PRISM closes the revenue loop, not just the program loop.

units.title: QuotePostCostBackflowEngine — assemble the round trip
units.scope: src/engines/QuotePostCostBackflowEngine.ts — orchestrates: quote_estimate → post emission → cycle_time_estimate → telemetry capture (PPG-MS11) → actual_cost_variance → recalibration delta → quote_revise. Single entry point.

units.title: Variance decomposition (per-stage attribution)
units.scope: src/engines/CostVarianceDecomposerEngine.ts — given a quoted vs actual variance, attributes it across pipeline stages (roughing/finishing/setup/probe/coolant/tool-change). Hands stage deltas to PPG-MS11 for kc1.1 calibration and PPG-MS14 for safety-predicate refinement.

units.title: Per-customer / per-machine / per-material accuracy tracking
units.scope: src/engines/QuoteAccuracyTrackerEngine.ts — rolling window of (customer, machine, material) → quoted vs actual; flags drift > σ; suggests next-quote calibration adjustments.

units.title: Shop owner dashboard (variance + margin alerts)
units.scope: web/src/pages/QuoteAccuracyDashboard.tsx — per-customer / per-machine variance heatmap; margin-alert feed; click-through to specific job + post + sidecar + telemetry trail.

units.title: Backflow regression: 50-job retrospective + forward 30-day pilot
units.scope: src/__tests__/QuoteBackflow.regression.test.ts — replay 50 historical JM Die jobs through the backflow engine; assert variance decomposition matches operator-known cause for ≥80% of cases. Forward 30-day pilot: 10 live jobs run through full backflow; assert quote accuracy improves by ≥10% across the run vs prior baseline.

units.title: Cycle-time estimation accuracy dashboard + dedicated metric ownership
units.scope: Dedicated cycle-time accuracy metric: |estimated - actual|/actual rolling window per (machine, material, feature). Closes the diffuse ownership gap flagged by value-coverage scrutiny: MS1 produces estimates, MS12 regression locks ±5%, MS16 measures + reports as a first-class metric. Surfaces in shop-owner dashboard from U-PPGM99 with drill-down per job.

completion_criteria: QuotePostCostBackflowEngine round-trips a real JM Die job end-to-end (quote → post → telemetry → variance → recalibrated quote)
Variance decomposer attributes ≥80% of cost variance to a specific pipeline stage on the 50-job retrospective
Quote accuracy tracker flags drift > σ per (customer, machine, material) tuple with suggested calibration delta
Shop-owner dashboard surfaces variance heatmap; margin-alert feed actionable in <60s
30-day pilot demonstrates ≥10% quote-accuracy improvement vs pre-backflow baseline (measured: |actual-quoted|/quoted)
